From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Forecasted monthly expenditure band & purchasing gates — follow-up

Samantha — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and three concrete asks so we can land procurement requirements with your finance team.

Summary of what we discussed (numbers rounded):
- Active users (MAUs projected): 25k — initial pilot 5k MAU for month 1–3.
- Avg tokens per active user/session: 2.8k tokens (prompt + generated) — we used conservative numbers.
- Projected tokens/month (production): 25k users * 2.8k tokens = ~70M tokens/month.
- Unit target: your stated goal of $X/1M tokens — you said you wanted to be broadly in the $10–30 / 1M token range depending on latency/quantization.

Two options we recommended on the call:
A) Self-serve Hosted plan with token-tier discounts (good for <$30k/month, fast onboarding)
B) Reserved/dedicated commit (recommended for sustained spend >$50k/month) — gives lower $/1M token and capacity guarantees.

What we need from you to validate procurement path:
1) Confirm target $/1M tokens (range or single target). This lets us map your 70M tokens to a monthly spend band.
2) Procurement gate: confirm threshold that requires a formal PO vs credit-card/expense path (you mentioned finance uses a $25k/month PO threshold; can you confirm?).
3) Timeline: desired contract start date for pilot vs full rollout (we should align billing/pricing months to your fiscal cadence).

Attachments: Redwood_monthly_estimate_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with token burn scenarios and three pricing options) and a short SOW template.

Next steps I propose: I’ll update the estimate using whatever $/1M target you confirm and then share a clean cost table your procurement team can use to decide PO vs credit card. If PO is required, we’ll prepare a one-page procurement sheet with billing and SLA terms for your PO team.

Thanks again — I’ll stand by for the three items above.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Thanks Ben — useful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Target $/1M tokens: we want to budget for $22/1M tokens as a planning baseline for months 1–6. If you can show tiered pricing down to $12/1M for larger commit tiers that would be ideal.
- Procurement gate: our procurement policy requires a PO for any recurring spend >$20k/month. Anything below that can be handled on a corporate card for pilot.
- Timeline: pilot start target = Oct 4 (2–3 week ramp), full rollout targeted for Jan 2027 if pilot metrics hold.

Tom Reeves (CC) will coordinate PO paperwork if we move to a committed plan. Procurement (procurement@greenfield.ai) should be looped for contracts and tax forms.

Also: we’d prefer a simple annual commit option if the economics align — can your team model a 12-month annual commit showing blended $/1M and monthly invoice amounts?

Appreciate the attachments — I’ll forward the XLSX to procurement for a sanity check.

— Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Product | Greenfield Analytics
